roles.U: encoder training/validation; architecture, objective, checkpoint and seed selection solely under U frozen objective
roles.Q: fresh TSB qualification only; no encoder selection
roles.D: historical explicitly permitted development plus Q after registered transition; readout/scaler/kernel/calibration-development/power only
roles.E: locked final primary and preregistered secondary; no construction or access in S1

Q_to_D_preregistration.timing: Owner signs this transition BEFORE any Q run
Q_to_D_preregistration.trigger: Q closed under fixed whole-roster adjudication with full exposure/failure ledger
Q_to_D_preregistration.if_pass: entire Q becomes D; no filtering or reclassification as untouched; allow fixed H scaler, frozen-capacity readouts, kernel/calibration-development and power estimation
Q_to_D_preregistration.if_fail_or_incomplete: exposed Q retained for failure diagnosis only; no BDD/training continuation absent separate Owner decision; never recycle as Q or E
Q_to_D_preregistration.unrun_members: retain frozen Q reservation and failure ledger; no automatic reassignment

independence: U/Q/D/E source-disjoint at log and token level when same data source; retain dataset/driver/session grouping where available; no windows from same source group crossing roles
D_partitions: D_AA_final_calibration: separately reserved independent logs, numerically freeze threshold before E; never encoder selection
E_lock_condition: encoder+H+normalization+kernel+null+numeric threshold from independent D_AA_final_calibration+operating point+E size+SAP frozen before E construction/unblinding; no E calibration
exclusions: union of all historical outcome-exposed log/token ledgers, engineering reservations, prior Stage6/7/7L/R0/R1/R2 exposures, U and D; missing provenance fails closed
reserved_not_exposed: HLC unrun engineering and A5 unselected reservations retain historical roles; do not falsely call them outcome-exposed
D_partition_rule: On passing Q, use frozen Q roster order: first floor(0.6N) logs D_fit, next floor(0.2N) D_calibration_development, rest D_FPR_evaluation_development. Historical additions require predeclared role/source bindings. Small partitions do not establish m=20 null calibration; report insufficient capacity, never borrow E or move logs after results.
